title: Principal Infrastructure and Operations Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Principal Entra ID Engineer provides engineering and operational ownership for identity and access capabilities across the Microsoft 365 tenants supporting the Enterprise 1099 population. The role is accountable for secure, reliable identity services and enterprise-aligned controls across the tenant portfolio.

Business Need

This role supports a dedicated engineering function responsible for governing and securing the Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments for USHealth Group, HealthMarkets, and First Family Insurance. The environments support roughly 10,000 external 1099 agents. The position will help align tenant operations, identity controls, email protections, telemetry, and change governance with enterprise policies while supporting the HealthMarkets Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Engineer and administer Microsoft Entra ID tenant configurations, authentication methods, enterprise applications, and identity integrations
* Design, implement, and maintain Conditional Access and multifactor authentication controls aligned with enterprise requirements
* Configure and support single sign-on integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect
* Administer Privileged Identity Management, just-in-time privileged access, role assignments, and access reviews
* Support identity lifecycle processes, including joiner, mover, and leaver scenarios for external agent populations
* Monitor identity service health, investigate authentication issues, and remediate configuration or control gaps
* Develop PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for repeatable administration, reporting, and control validation
* Support identity discovery, mapping, tenant build, migration, cutover, and hypercare activities for HealthMarkets
* Produce operational documentation, standard operating procedures, control evidence, and change records
* Participate in an offshore support model, operational handoffs, incident response, and planned changes
  
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* Hands-on experience engineering and administering Microsoft Entra ID in a large or complex environment
* Experience with Conditional Access, MFA, enterprise applications, identity governance, and privileged access
* Experience troubleshooting authentication, authorization, federation, provisioning, and access issues
* Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, provisioning, and directory synchronization concepts
* Proficiency with PowerShell; experience with Microsoft Graph is strongly desired
* Proven ability to work within formal change, incident, problem, and security governance processes
* Proven solid written communication and documentation skills in a distributed engineering environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* Relevant Microsoft security, Azure, or Microsoft 365 certification
* Experience supporting separate or externally facing Microsoft 365 tenants and large contractor populations
* Experience with migration programs, identity source-of-truth design, and cross-tenant or Google-to-Microsoft transitions
* Experience using Rally or comparable Kanban/work management tools for project, operational task, and dependency tracking
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, Splunk, Compass, Maester, or comparable governance and telemetry tooling
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and enterprise identity security patterns

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Front Desk Executive
description:
**Job Description – Front Desk Executive**

**Position:** Front Desk Executive  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Department:** Administration / Front Desk Executive  
**Location:** Vaishali  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a professional, well\-groomed, and customer\-oriented **Front Desk Executive** with experience in the **Real Estate industry**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the reception area, handling visitors and calls, coordinating with clients, and providing administrative support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day front\-office operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the front desk and reception area professionally.
* Greet and welcome clients, customers, visitors, and business associates.
* Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department.
* Coordinate with the **Sales, CRM, and Project/Site teams** for client requirements and appointments.
* Schedule and manage meetings, appointments, and site visits.
* Maintain visitor records, call logs, and other front\-office registers.
* Handle basic client follow\-ups and coordinate with the concerned sales/CRM executive.
* Maintain records of walk\-in clients and ensure proper lead information is captured.
* Assist the sales team in managing walk\-in customers and initial project inquiries.
* Coordinate refreshments and meeting arrangements for clients and visitors.
* Support administrative activities and other office coordination as required.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.

**Real Estate\-Specific Responsibilities**

* Handle **walk\-in clients and property/project inquiries**.
* Record and maintain details of prospective customers and leads.
* Coordinate **site visit appointments** with the sales/site team.
* Provide basic information about ongoing projects, locations, amenities, and available services as instructed.
* Coordinate with the CRM/Sales team regarding client visits and follow\-ups.
* Maintain daily records of walk\-ins, calls, inquiries, and site visits.
* Assist in collecting and organizing basic customer documents when required.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer\-handling skills.
* Professional personality and presentable appearance.
* Basic knowledge of **real estate projects and customer handling**.
* Good coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Good Hindi and English communication skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Prior experience in **Real Estate / Property / Construction / Builder industry** will be preferred.

**Key Performance Areas (KRA)**

* Professional handling of visitors and clients.
* Call and visitor management.
* Walk\-in lead generation and accurate data recording.
* Client communication and follow\-up coordination.

Interested candidates, get in touch with Ms. Nisha at 9311128718 or nishatomar.radon@gmail.com

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
